notes.title: Endless Mode Update
notes.content:
While it is more a coincidence than anything, we can claim this is in honor of the Summer Sale 😊.

First we fixed some minor bugs with the ghost scroll.  It did not impart damage immunity to players, it does now.  As part of a related bug we were also forced to make it so the Harpoon Gun is no longer usable while a ghost scroll is active.

Second, we added a restart run button when you die during a normal run that will, well, restart the run with the same settings.

Last but by no means least, we added an endless mode that unlocks after you have gotten to the bottom of the mines at least once.  Endless mode includes some new boss variants, modified difficulty to account for the endless nature of it, and a new curse system.

Have fun discovering what was released when the Dwarves, well, They Dug Too Deep!
